name: readit
description: Readit — a personal library for books, magazines, newspapers and PDFs, with excerpt notebooks and an integrated Malayalam/English dictionary.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/smoke.mjs && node e2e/periodical.mjs && node e2e/pwa.mjs
